verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI ships a GitHub Action integration that auto-triggers on events (PR review, issue triage, @mention delegation) and supports non-interactive/scripted invocation for workflow automation, which enables trigger-based autonomous maintenance tasks. However, there's no documented cron/schedule-based 'always-on agent' runtime, no persistent background daemon, and community reports describe it as unreliable/proactive-averse ('completely useless for anything proactive', hallucinated file deletion), undercutting confidence in unattended autonomous operation. Missing for 10: native scheduling/cron support, evidence of long-running always-on agent processes, and hands-on confirmation of safe autonomous fixes without supervision.
